## Added

- Text extraction mode with per-page output, concatenated output, and `all`-pages single-file output.
- JSON CLI output for page cutting, text extraction, and page count, including file sizes and PNG scale metadata.
- Page-count mode and explicit cutting mode selection via `--format`.
- Machine-readable extraction errors in JSON, keyed by page number.

## Fixed

- CLI mode validation now reports a clear error when extraction and cutting flags are mixed or no mode is selected.
- Extraction of unreadable or out-of-bounds pages now surfaces page-level failures consistently for automation.
